curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42045-1-1.pdf (book 1 builds this hydroplane, finished on page 58; book 2, omr/instructions/42045-1-2.pdf, builds the alternate model)

functions.does: Pushing the hydroplane along on the two small wheels under its nose runs the inline four-cylinder engine: the wheels' axle carries a 20-tooth bevel gear that turns a 12-tooth bevel gear on the front of the crankshaft, so the four pistons go up and down.
functions.source: book: engine steps 7-12 (pages 8-10), wheels steps 31-35 (pages 27-28, the tan bevel gear on the wheel axle), steps 38-45 (pages 31-36)

functions.does: The engine spins the propeller at the back: an axle in the crankshaft's rear end carries a 24-tooth gear, which turns an 8-tooth gear on the propeller's shaft above it, three times as fast.
functions.source: book: step 13 (page 11, the axle goes into the crank's yellow end and takes the 24-tooth gear), steps 64-65 (pages 55-56, the propeller)
